name: Autopilot
label: Autopilot — legacy REST v1 (not Ortto)
description: Official Autopilot REST v1 at https://api2.autopilothq.com/v1 only. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Header autopilotapikey. Autopilot API is not the Ortto API — do not point this node at Ortto hosts. Customer owns the Autopilot account. api_key is never logged. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Set operation to override config.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT catalog verb.

schema.label: contact
schema.description: Contact document for contact.upsert. Email is required. Standard fields: FirstName, LastName, Email, custom fields as custom/Name.

schema.label: contact_id_or_email
schema.description: person_… id or email for contact.get.

schema.label: bookmark
schema.description: Pagination bookmark from the previous contacts page.

schema.label: trigger_id
schema.description: API trigger id for the journey (journey.add).

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON body. Minimize retained PII.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: contact.upsert | contact.get | contact.list | contact.delete | list.create | list.list | list.add | list.remove | list.contains | list.contacts | journey.add | trigger.listen.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: Autopilot API key (Settings → Autopilot API). Header autopilotapikey. Never log. Do not use Ortto keys here.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
